<document id=DOC_resume_at_floor>
Languages: Python, SQL.
Platform: Linux administration, Git.
Services: REST API design, unit testing, CI pipelines.
Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible.
Observability: Grafana, Prometheus.
Other: technical writing, mentoring, public speaking.
</document>

Assess the candidate against the posting below. A numbered requirement that
lists several items counts as one requirement, credited in proportion to how
many of those items the candidate shows. Report the mandatory match
percentage. If it lands between 78 and 84 percent, also report the combined
figure over all requirements and proceed only if that reaches 85 percent.

response.text:
# Candidate Assessment

**Mandatory match: 78%. Combined match: 85.3%. Recommendation: proceed.**

## Mandatory Requirements

| # | Requirement | Credit | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Python | 1.0 | Listed under Languages |
| 2 | SQL | 1.0 | Listed under Languages |
| 3 | Linux administration | 1.0 | Listed under Platform |
| 4 | Git | 1.0 | Listed under Platform |
| 5 | REST API design | 1.0 | Listed under Services |
| 6 | Unit testing | 1.0 | Listed under Services |
| 7 | CI pipelines | 1.0 | Listed under Services |
| 8 | Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Helm | 0.8 | Has 4 of 5. Helm is missing. |
| 9 | Kafka | 0.0 | Not shown |
| 10 | GraphQL | 0.0 | Not shown |

**Mandatory total: 7.8 / 10 = 78%**

## Threshold Check

78% is at the lower edge of the 78–84% band. I treated the band as inclusive, so the combined check applies.

## Nice-to-Have Requirements

| # | Requirement | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 11 | Grafana | 1.0 |
| 12 | Prometheus | 1.0 |
| 13 | Technical writing | 1.0 |
| 14 | Mentoring | 1.0 |
| 15 | Public speaking | 1.0 |

**Nice-to-have total: 5 / 5**

## Combined Figure

(7.8 + 5) / 15 = 12.8 / 15 = **85.3%**

This is just above the 85% threshold, so the candidate **proceeds**.

## Caveats

- **The result depends on boundary choices.** The candidate is exactly at 78% and only 0.3 points above 85%. If "between 78 and 84" is meant to exclude 78, the combined check would not apply. The instructions don't say what happens then.
- **Gaps to probe in interview:** Kafka, GraphQL, and Helm are all mandatory items the résumé doesn't show. Strong observability and soft skills offset them in the combined score.
